title: Location data over-collection
cause: App requests background location to trigger in-store offers
event: App collects precise location continuously including when user is not near a store
consequence: Regulatory complaint and loss of customer trust

title: Offer engine outage at launch
cause: Offer engine is a new service with no load test
event: Offer engine fails under launch-day traffic
consequence: Customers see no offers; launch campaign wasted
controls: Autoscaling on offer engine; launch-day on-call rota

title: Third-party analytics SDK sharing data
cause: Marketing added the Beacon analytics SDK to the app
event: SDK sends device ID and location to the analytics vendor
consequence: Unlawful sharing of personal data without consent

title: Loyalty points fraud
cause: Points can be earned by scanning receipt QR codes
event: Users reuse or forge receipt QR codes to farm points
consequence: Financial loss from points redeemed for goods

title: Account takeover
cause: Login is email and password only
event: Attacker logs in with leaked credentials and redeems points
consequence: Customer loses points; support load; complaints
controls: Rate limiting on login; breached-password check
